title: Keep the exact complementary-space dependence in the local response
statement: Near(eta,z)=(0,E),let P0=psi_theta B(psi_theta,.),Q0=1-P0,f=Vpsi_theta and D_eta(z)=Q0(H_theta+eta V-z)Q0 on ran Q0. Then F=E-z-eta^2 B(f,D_eta^-1 f),G_psi=1/F,and G_p=B(p_Q,D_eta^-1 p_Q)+[a_p-eta B(f,D_eta^-1 p_Q)]^2/F are exact local continued-response formulas.

requires: Transpose bilinear form,full closed complementary space and locally invertible D_eta retained
provides: Exact nonlinear-eta pole equation without finite-rank truncation of V
Explicit bare and dressed visibility and removable harmonic-atom cancellation
For the convention a/(lambda-z),the actual pole coefficient contains -1/F_z;the squared bare factor is a NUMERATOR,not by itself the residue
assumptions: C86 is a valid consequence and explicit formula,not another independent pole theorem or a necessary repair of C74
Replacing D_eta by the odd unperturbed resolvent gives only the second-order expansion
Coarse wrong-sign quadrature and nonconverged-root diagnostics remain failures;small residual alone is not a validated pole
costs: Full complement and exact eta dependence;no numerical pole enclosure
Warm integrator review does not claim rerunning its expensive new integration script;the earlier C74 contour replay is separate
